pages.title: Cleansing Methods
pages.text: The $(curse)cursed earth$() can be cleansed through several methods. The most accessible is creating a $(item)salt circle$() and using a $(item)Purification Staff$().$(br2)For larger areas, construct a $(gold)Solar Spire$() to channel $(deity)Ra's$() light.

pages.title: Salt
pages.text: Pure salt crystals used to create protective circles. Place salt dust on the ground in a circle pattern to form a ritual boundary.

pages.title: Purification Staff
pages.text: Channels divine energy to cleanse cursed earth. Stand within a salt circle and hold right-click for 3 seconds to purify up to 8 blocks. Costs 10 Ankh per use.

pages.title: Status Effect Removal
pages.text: The $(item)Eternal Sigil$() removes all curses and status effects instantly, granting temporary protection buffs. Perfect for emergencies when the curse takes hold. One-time use only.

pages.title: Solar Spire
pages.text: The $(gold)Solar Spire$() is the most powerful cleansing structure. It purifies large areas, removes cursed entities, and creates lasting protection zones. Build the plinth, crucible, and pyramidion in sequence.$(br2)See the $(l:blocks/solar_spire)Solar Spire entry$(/l) for details.
